gloss: to spare time; to find time for

definitions.gloss: to spare time; to make time for; to find time
definitions.explanation: To allocate or set aside time from a busy schedule for something. Implies that one is busy and making an effort to find time.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}を{割|さ}いて⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: They spared their time for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{忙|いそが}しいところ→お忙しいところ：23577_oisogashiitokoro⟧{時間|じかん}を{割|さ}いて⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for taking the time out of your busy schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{時間|じかん}を{割|さ}くようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I try to set aside at least a little time every day for reading.

notes:
The verb ⟦{割|さ}く→割く：11820_saku⟧ means to split or divide, giving the image of carving out a portion from a busy schedule.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {時間|じかん}を{割|さ}く: to spare/make time
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{時間|じかん}を{割|さ}く: to devote time to ~
- {時間|じかん}を{割|さ}いて⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧: to have someone spare their time (humble/polite)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{時間|じかん}を{割|さ}く: to spare time for study
- ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{時間|じかん}を{割|さ}く: to make time for hobbies

REGISTER:
Very common in polite business contexts, especially when thanking someone: ⟦お{忙|いそが}しいところ→お忙しいところ：23577_oisogashiitokoro⟧{時間|じかん}を{割|さ}いて⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make time (more casual)
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take time (neutral)
